verification_method: Official Valve Steam News announcements; 2024/2025 announcement capsule artwork visually inspected. Pacific offsets computed with zoneinfo, not a fixed PT offset.
research_network_note: External research was limited to official event-calendar verification. Audit execution is offline with zero network requests. Web-tool underlying HTTP request counts are not exposed; four official source files were successfully downloaded directly and one earlier sandbox DNS attempt failed. No ITAD or pricing requests.

events.source_title: Valve Steam News: The Steam Autumn Sale is just a few days away! (2023-11-17)
events.verification_evidence: Announcement explicitly specifies November 21 at 10 AM PST (UTC -8) through November 28 at 10 AM PST (UTC -8).

events.source_title: Valve Steam News: The Steam Autumn Sale is on now! (2024-11-27)
events.verification_evidence: Official announcement artwork specifies November 27–December 4 at 10 AM Pacific; announcement text separately confirms the December 4 end at 10 AM PST.

events.source_title: Valve Steam News: Steam Autumn Sale is here! (2025-09-29)
events.verification_evidence: Official announcement artwork specifies September 29–October 6 at 10 AM PT; text separately confirms the October 6 end at 10 AM PT. Both dates are PDT (UTC -7).
